text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant, pant*... Trainer... Just... 
one more rep...
choice_data_list: Yeah, that'll be the finishing touch...!

Yeah, and that'll be the finishing 
touch...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Aiming for the Kawasaki Kinen. Wonder 
Acute's days grew fiercely intense.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A late surge that pushes past the limit. 
In theory... it is possible.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, that theory completely ignores 
the feelings of the person performing it. 
Demanding this kind of effort is pure 
insanity.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Kyaaaaaaaaaaaagh...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as Wonder Acute cast aside her 
wisdom—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I cast my feelings aside as well.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Taaaryaaaaaaaahhhhh...!!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa... haa... With this... 
Trainer-san... I can't... anymore...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute collapses onto the sand. I 
sit quietly beside her, offering comfort.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even if I cast my heart aside— I couldn't 
stop the tears streaming down my cheeks.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... I'm so sorry for putting you 
through so much pain because of me...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Please don't cry... please... Forgive 
me...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Together, we tasted hell. However—with 
this, our preparations are completely 
thorough.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And on the day of the race—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Hello, everyone in Kawasaki~☆ Nice to meet 
you all!!!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I'm so sorry I couldn't make it sooner! To 
make up for keeping you waiting today—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I, Smart Falcon, will hype everyone up 
alongside all our friends!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (UOOOOOOOOOH!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Smart Falcon is at the center of the 
circle today as always. The leading figure 
who has kept the dirt scene thriving all 
this time."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, today, no matter how great that 
presence may be, I have no intention of 
surrendering the spotlight.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"First—the entrance presentation. I beat 
upon the prepared drums, letting their 
sound ring out."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
(THUD! THUD! THUD, THUD! 
THUMP-THUMP-THUMP!)

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Huh, what's with this performance~?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Is that a period drama? Aha☆ Looks kinda 
fun!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for getting everyone pumped up, 
Acute-san!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: How are you feeling, Falco-san?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Acute... san...? Huh, something feels...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We decided to keep the staging purely 
funny and entertaining. However—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Smart Falcon naturally seemed to notice 
it, too. The aura of Wonder Acute, who had 
grown all the more seasoned and mature."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Falco-san, thanks for inviting me to run 
with you today. But...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I don't need anyone leading me around 
anymore. Uh, what was it again~...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Center Position Zero"? Today, I'm 
thinking of taking that center spot from 
Falco.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I have to rise above, even in brilliance. 
In order to help so many people get back 
on their feet. For that sake—

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
After all, I ended up making Trainer cry 
so very much too.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Acute-san, somehow... are you different 
from before...?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I've stepped on the stage far more 
times... And yet, she looks like much more 
of a veteran...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It wasn't just her tone that made it seem 
that way. Wonder Acute had spent an 
intensely devoted amount of time preparing 
for this race.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“—Having brought her hidden veteran 
cunning to full maturity all at once, she 
made it this far. Bearing a strain that 
far exceeded her sheer resilience.”

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
If this... if the way she is right now... 
is the true Acute-san...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Urrrgh... ALRIGHT!! Let's do this, let's 
gooo☆

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: ...!? F-Falco-san!?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ah, sorry! Sorry, sorry, I just couldn't 
help it...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Because I was so happy! I've had many 
girls look up to me before, but...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Because no one has ever told Falco, 'I 
want to take the center position'!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Acute-san, I can believe you, right? You 
truly, genuinely mean that, right?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I'm not lying one bit. Today's star 
is me. It's really me, you know.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I'll give Falco-san plenty of headpats 
later, okay?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha☆ Not a chance! If you truly feel 
that way, then Acute-san, you're not—my 
junior anymore.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Come on! As my rival competing for the top 
spot in the Dirt General Election!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Smart Falcon, too, had long been yearning 
for such a fierce contest.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Now—a new page in history is written. All 
made possible because Wonder Acute dared 
to challenge her limits here at the 
Kawasaki Kinen."
